OpenIdConnect.ExpectedAuthority: The authority tokens are expected to be issued from.
OpenIdConnect.ClientId: The ID of the client users should authenticate under.
OpenIdConnect.ClientSecret: The secret of the client users should authenticate under.

ManagementApiClient.Endpoint: The endpoint of the Management API.
ManagementApiClient.ClientId: The Client ID to use for authenticating tokens.
ManagementApiClient.ClientSecret: The Client Secret to use for authenticating tokens.

AssetsOriginOptions.AssetsEndpointHttps: URL to static assets server for css/js/images. Expects base url from where files are served from.

MainSiteOptions.Url: Url of main site for redirecting users out of management service pages.
